title: Statistical mechanical emergence of continuous time
html:
Remark. Statistical mechanical emergence of continuous time

The information-theoretic time acts as a strict counting measure on discrete Reeb operations. The passage to a smooth time coordinate entails a statistical coarse-graining, structurally analogous to the emergence of thermodynamic quantities from microscopic dynamics.

The analogy. See Table.

The mechanism of passing from a Riemann sum to an integral drives both the emergence of thermodynamic equilibrium from molecular collisions and the emergence of continuous time from discrete Reeb operations.

Crossover at \sim 10 operations. At q = q_0 (local substrate q), we have t_P \approx 10.1 (iterations per Reeb circuit). The central limit theorem applies to sums of \sim 10 independent operations. Statistical fluctuations scale as O(1/\sqrt{10}) \approx 30\%. This large variance implies individual discrete steps are not fully smoothed. Quantum-gravitational discreteness reliably produces O(\hbar_q) \approx 10\% corrections to the continuous Reeb flow.

Conversely, at q = 1.01 (t_P \approx 101), fluctuations drop to O(1/\sqrt{101}) \approx 10\%. At q = 1.001, they fall to \sim 3\% and time effectively smooths.

Exceptional divisor dynamics at each scale. At the Big Bang (t_P = 1), each Planck unit captures exactly one braiding evaluation on the exceptional divisor. The link-length resolution increases by precisely one crossing per tick. Dynamics remain fully resolved. The Julia set iteration f_q executes once.

At q = q_0 (t_P \approx 10), each Planck unit executes \sim 10 braiding evaluations. The exceptional divisor undergoes \sim 10 iterations of f_q. The aggregate effect resolving 10 crossings is fully observable. However, the intermediate states cannot be individually resolved at the Planck scale.

At the classical limit (t_P \to \infty), infinitely many iterations fill each unit. The Julia set dynamics degenerates into continuous Reeb flow. The orbit structure flattens into the smooth invariant measure \mu_J.

Connection to jet prolongation. Each Reeb operation executes exactly one jet prolongation (Planck steps as jet orders). The \sim 10 jet prolongations occurring within a single Planck time generate a statistical jet, which averages the intermediate polynomial orders. The continuous limit (q \to 1) recovers the analytic germ J^\infty E. The smooth Taylor series arises as the thermodynamic limit of the discrete jet tower.
